## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Market mixed: Materials/Healthcare/Consumer Staples showing strength while Technology and Financials lag, supporting a neutral read with mixed confirmations.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%). Materials and Energy also strong: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%), EOG ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%). Industrials and Financials under pressure with LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) and JPM CORRECTION (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors) and style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%), LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%). Weakness concentrated in select large-cap names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40%), FCX (1W: +15.30%), MRK (1W: +12.30%), NEM (1W: +11.74%), CRM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +33.29%). Major divergence present: AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) — tactical caution, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with CORRECTION pressure: AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%). Tech underperformed this week and is a source of the market’s internal divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Soft near-term: JPM CORRECTION (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%). Financials show mixed internals and are not broadly leading the market.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Clear relative strength: MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%). Sector breadth supportive and driving part of the market’s upside.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Materials and Healthcare exposure given leadership in top performers and confirmed ABOVE TREND stocks; reduce exposure to lagging Utilities and select large-cap Tech names exhibiting CORRECTION/BELOW TREND behavior. Maintain size discipline given major divergence among Big Tech leaders.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%).  
BEARISH: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare and Materials (both showing multiple ABOVE TREND names; part of Breadth: 5/11).  
BEARISH: Utilities and Industrials remain vulnerable after steep 1W weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA resistance test ~ near recent highs to confirm CORRECTION continuation; AAPL support/momentum around recent 1M pivot to validate RECOVERY; JPM horizontal breakout level to confirm reversal from CORRECTION to leadership; EL continuation above recent breakout would confirm sector leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+55): Eli Lilly launches oral weight-loss pill in UK — price confirming ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%).  
NUE (+50): Tariff news bullish for steel prices but price showing CORRECTION divergence (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +1.03%) — news positive, price weak.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (-55): Large share sale headline with heavy selling, price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) — sentiment confirmed.  
META (-50): Negative attention on regulatory/social issues, price BELOW TREND (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) — sentiment confirmed.  
CVX (-50): Target cut headlines but stock ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +6.50%) — news/price divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Healthcare and Materials showing relative strength: MRK ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND, EL ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk is major divergence in Big Tech (AAPL RECOVERY vs MSFT/NVDA CORRECTION) and negative news on INTC/META that could widen dispersion.
